description: Stations de vélo "VELOPOP" - Grand Avignon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Avignon. The Grand Avignon has set up a bicycle rental service throughout its territory. For more information, do not hesitate to consult the dedicated webpage: www.velopop.frThis database refers to the different stations available with their name, address, geographical coordinates and number of bikes. Coverage: Grand Avignon. The portal shows the English title as "Bike stations "VELOPOP" - Grand Avignon" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grand Avignon. Its keywords include transport, velo, mobilite, mode-doux, station, velo-libre-service. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, GEOJSON, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
